_help: Change these during class to switch models. The helper rereads this file on every request, so no restart is needed. mode: 'real' calls the models below, 'simulated' uses simulated_responses.json. The top part is voice to text; 'note' is the second AI step that drafts the note from the transcript.

note._help: Drafts the note from the real transcript. Needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in .env and: python3 -m pip install anthropic. Set enabled to false to keep the sample note. location: where the agency works, so misheard place names can be corrected to real places there.

document._help: Reads a photo or PDF of release papers, an ID or a letter so the note can be checked against it. Uses the same ANTHROPIC_API_KEY as the note. Set enabled to false to use the sample documents only.
